import importlib.util,json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);scripts=root/'.claude/scripts'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('sup',scripts/'factory-supervisor.py');sup=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(sup)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='runner-argv-audit-') as directory:
    temp=Path(directory); marker=temp/'never-created'; payloads=['$(touch '+str(marker)+')','`touch '+str(marker)+'`','"; touch '+str(marker)+'; #','two words\nnext line']
    capture=temp/'capture.py';capture.write_text('import json,sys;print(json.dumps(sys.argv[1:]))\n')
    command=[sys.executable,str(capture),*payloads]
    result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(scripts/'foreground-watchdog.py'),'--timeout','3','--',*command],cwd=temp,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10,env={'PATH':os.defpath,'HOME':'/nonexistent','LANG':'C','LC_ALL':'C','PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'})
    assert result.returncode==0,(result.returncode,result.stderr)
    assert json.loads(result.stdout)==payloads and not marker.exists()
    db=temp/'runtime.sqlite';store=sup.runtime.Store(db);store.enqueue('T-1','a'*64,[])
    assert sup.supervise(db,'T-1',command,temp,temp/'attempts',timeout=5,lease=3)==0
    attempt=next((temp/'attempts').glob('T-1-*'))
    assert json.loads((attempt/'worker.log').read_text())==payloads and not marker.exists()
    assert store.get('T-1')['state']=='verifying' and json.loads((attempt/'outcome.json').read_text())['engineering_verified'] is False
    print(json.dumps({'watchdog_literal_argv':True,'actual_guardian_literal_argv':True,'payloads':4,'injected_command_executed':False,'task_state':'verifying','engineering_verified':False,'isolation_scope':'temporary local native fixture; no shell program was requested and no container claim'}))
